contexts.text: (These Spirits) relate to the ganglia in the body, into which a nerve flows, and is thence divaricated into a number of fibres, of which some are conveyed in one direction, some in another... Described. SE 3837.

Evident... from the knots which are called ganglions, into which there enter some fibres from every province, and therein commingle themselves, and when differently joined together go forth to their functions, and this again and again.
How (the fibres) weave themselves into knots or ganglia...
